title: Being able to press Super key then the Left Arrow key to use the keyboard on the Panel
line: In Kickoff, pressing Enter on a category in the sidebar now moves the keyboard focus into that category's apps.
explanation: Kickoff's list view handles Enter the same way in the sidebar and in the app list: it triggers the current item. For a category that only re-selects it, so the focus stayed in the sidebar and the user had to press the Right arrow to reach the apps. Now Enter on a sidebar entry that has children (categories, Places sections) moves the focus into the content list, like the arrow key; top-level apps placed in the sidebar still launch.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: move focus to a category's apps on Enter

Pressing Enter on a category in the sidebar re-selected the category
and left the focus there, so only the arrow key reached its apps. Enter
on a sidebar entry with children now moves the focus into the list.

BUG: 515077

patches.diff:
From 7cd33787dcaf8161cce028274f1932075783ddc4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:05:56 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: move focus to a category's apps on Enter

Pressing Enter on a category in the sidebar re-selected the category
and left the focus there, so only the arrow key reached its apps. Enter
on a sidebar entry with children now moves the focus into the list.

BUG: 515077
---
 applets/kickoff/KickoffListView.qml | 5 ++++-
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/KickoffListView.qml b/applets/kickoff/KickoffListView.qml
index 839ea277e8..309943485a 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/KickoffListView.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/KickoffListView.qml
@@ -327,7 +327,10 @@ EmptyPage {
                     case Qt.Key_Return:
                         /* Fall through*/
                     case Qt.Key_Enter:
-                        if (launchMatchTimer.running) {
+                        if (root.isSidebar && (currentItem as AbstractKickoffItemDelegate)?.model.hasChildren !== false) {
+                            // A category has nothing to launch: go to its contents, like the arrow key does
+                            kickoff.contentArea?.forceActiveFocus(Qt.TabFocusReason)
+                        } else if (launchMatchTimer.running) {
                             launchMatchTimer.stop()
                             launchMatchTimer.triggered()
                         } else if (!kickoff.runnerModel.querying || view.currentItem?.text.toLowerCase().includes(kickoff.runnerModel.query.toLowerCase())) {
--

media.caption: Super, Left, Down twice, Enter: Development stays focused in the sidebar (frame identical to before Enter)
Same steps: Enter moves the focus to the first app of Development
Then Down: the sidebar moves to Games
Then Down: the next app (Icon Explorer) is selected, Return launches it

review.text: The 4-line change in KickoffListView.qml cleanly implements the confirmed accessibility/usability fix: pressing Return/Enter on a sidebar category or Places section (hasChildren !== false) moves focus to kickoff.contentArea just like the arrow key, while top-level apps in the sidebar (hasChildren === false) still launch. It is direction-independent for RTL, leaves search and content-area activation untouched, and the before/after screenshots clearly verify focus moving into the category's app list.
